summary: English and Chinese first-party discovery identified the official Anyang Tianditu portal hosted by the Anyang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau, plus national MNR registration/catalogue resources. Public map HTML and current JavaScript were inspected; the available anonymous functions were basemap, place search, geocoding/search, administrative, routing, and transit. No public cadastral parcel layer or safe ID-plus-geometry response was qualified, so no GeoJSON sample was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, direct requests, route outcomes, schema/CRS checks, safe field allowlist, scope limits, and uncertainty are recorded in city-9424-xujiagou.json. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, private tokens, TLS bypass, or unsafe-field request occurred.
